heroHeadline: Day 965: Imad Aqel — Last Surviving October 7 Senior Architect — Identified as NILI Target; 33 Days to Supreme Court July 1 Accountability Deadline
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. May 29, 2026 (Day 965 / Ceasefire Day 232): Imad Aqel — Hamas's 'home front' logistics and weapons commander — has been identified as the sole surviving senior Hamas figure connected to the October 7, 2023 planning circle, following the NILI-campaign killings of Sinwar (Oct 2024), Shambari (Apr 29), Haddad (May 16), and Odeh (May 27). Aqel survived by staying out of the public command structure; Israel attempted to kill him in 2003 and bombed his home in 2009. No new Hamas Al-Qassam Brigades supreme commander has been announced since Odeh's death — Hamas's military succession is in deep crisis. The Knesset coalition's Kallner inquiry bill — stripped of 'independent investigation' language and barring judges — is advancing toward its first full Knesset plenum reading; opposition parties pre-committed to an immediate Supreme Court challenge. 33 days remain until the Israeli Supreme Court's July 1, 2026 accountability deadline. The Beyachad alliance (Bennett-Lapid) pledges an independent state commission as Day 1 of any new government. All 251 hostages accounted for as of January 26, 2026.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Israel Police, UN OCHA, Israeli government, Bloomberg, Reuters, AP, Haaretz, Times of Israel, Jerusalem Post, Washington Post, Al Jazeera, WSJ, and institutional analyses. Casualty figures are official Israeli counts; Hamas-theater figures are separately noted and contested. All 251 hostages accounted for as of January 26, 2026. Cumulative conflict dead (Oct 7, 2023 - May 29, 2026): 72,797+ Palestinians per OCHA/Gaza MoH/WAFA. Ceasefire in effect since Oct 10, 2025; 3,005+ violations documented — 857+ Palestinians killed since ceasefire (Day 232 as of May 29). May 29 (Day 965): Imad Aqel identified as sole surviving senior October 7 architect (NILI target); no new Qassam Brigades commander announced; 33 days to Supreme Court July 1 deadline; Kallner bill advancing to first Knesset plenum reading. May 28 (Day 964): Knesset panel restores 'massacre' to Oct. 7 memorial bill after backlash; Hamas funerals for Gaza City deputy commander Aslim and northern Gaza brigade commander Beck (killed May 27); 34 days to deadline. May 27 (Day 963): IDF kills Mohammed Odeh — Hamas military wing commander and October 7 architect — on Eid al-Adha; 35 days to deadline. May 22 (Day 958): WSJ reveals NILI task force — 'hundreds' of ~3,000 participants killed/arrested. May 21 (Day 957): Board of Peace presents UNSC report; Hamas named 'principal obstacle' to Phase Two. May 16 (Day 952): IDF kills al-Haddad — last October 7 architect before Odeh's appointment. October 7 Perpetrators Eliminated: Sinwar (Oct 16, 2024), Shambari (Apr 29, 2026), Haddad (May 16, 2026), Odeh (May 27, 2026). Last survivor: Imad Aqel (NILI target). Accountability: Kallner bill advancing; 33 days to July 1 deadline; Beyachad pledges Day-1 state commission.
